author: KroestV2
body: I consider making a few maps for the Avicus, but i want to know what your policies are regarding the submitted maps. Is the author of a loaded map always allowed to request you to unload one of his maps? Do you contact the author if you want to make big changes/remake a map?
body_tagged: I consider making a few maps for the Avicus, but i want to know what your policies are regarding the submitted maps. Is the author of a loaded map always allowed to request you to unload one of his maps? Do you contact the author if you want to make big changes/remake a map?
title: What are your map policies?

replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body: If you submit a map and it is put into rotations, you are not allowed to take it back unless we see that the map doesn't fit the server and has bad gameplay. If your map is used on another server, we won't take the map. If you take a map from another player and submit it as your own, you will be forum banned. If we want to make edits to your map, we don't really have to contact you. We edit it ourselves.

If your map is used on another server, we won't take the map. If you take a map from another player and submit it as your own, you will be forum banned. If we want to make edits to your map, we don't really have to contact you. We edit it ourselves.

replies.body:
you are not allowed to take it back

Any chance this may change in the future? For me and some other people this really is a breaking point. If you want to attract more mapmakers you may want to consider changing this.

replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body: You submitted it to the Avicus Network. Submitting it gives us the permission to do anything with the map. It becomes part of us and we will not remove it unless we deem that the map isn't fit for rotations.

replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body: we don't do it like how we originally did it back when you were a mapdev. A mapdev isn't allowed to accept it just because they themselves like it. We put it through a process that takes 2-4 weeks which all mapdevelopers must put a response into a document. if the map has 5/9 greens then it is accepted. Sometimes, it would be something like "3 reds, 2 greens, 4 yellows" which throws it off and the map must be reassessed.
